about: how the rebuilt keys were made. The keys, the direction files and the LoRA are not included: they were written by experimental scripts
edit: the end-of-turn form of part 2 on Qwen3.5-4B (Q8_0): a switch at layer 22 that adds the end-of-turn token's row direction (no reply) and a switch at layer 25 that adds the row direction of the acknowledgment marker; only the two position-0 keys were replaced, the neurons and directions are unchanged
method: least squares with equal weight per cell (cell = kind of input x stretch of the reply), the regularization coefficient chosen by 5-fold cross-validation on the build set, in two stages (the second stage re-reads the hidden states with the first-stage switches in place)
candidates: three candidates (later turns added; later turns and system prompts added; the same with the conversation shape as part of the cells), one chosen on the development set by a rule fixed in advance

gne_eval.note: gne eval at scale 0 and 1 (copied from its output; needs the model to recount)
